title: Paper Boats in the Rain | Kids Song, Nursery Rhymes, Rhymes for Toddlers | BuBu TV - English
description:
A rainy day adventure where a little frog jumps onto a paper boat and tips it over, but a kind apology and teamwork build a bigger boat for everyone.
This song teaches toddlers about sharing, saying sorry, and working together.
Sing along with the paper boats, the splashing puddles, and the warm call to hot pakoras at home!

Drip, drip, drip, the rain is here
Clouds go boom, boom, boom
Splash, splash, splash, splash
Let's go out and play!
Float, float, float my boat
On the rainy pond
Swish, swish, swish, swish
My little paper boat!
Hop, hop, hop, a froggy comes
"Ribbit, ribbit," he sings
Jump, jump, jump, jump, onto the boat!
Oh no! The boat tips over!
Float, float, float my boat
On the rainy pond
Swish, swish, swish, swish
My little paper boat!
The little frog says "sorry, sorry"
Brother laughs, "It's okay!"
Let's make a big boat together
Room for you and me!
Float, float, float my boat
On the rainy pond
Swish, swish, swish, swish
My little paper boat!
Mummy calls, "Come in, come in!"
Hot pakoras, yum, yum
Rain, rain, rain, rain
La la la, see you again!
